description: For a Team owner: prepares approving one held order (from list_pending_approvals) and returns the summary to show the customer and a confirmation_token. Nothing is decided until confirm is called after they agree. Approving an on-account order sends it to production; approving a card order makes it payable by any member. A member who is not an owner cannot approve. Needs a signed-in Printdash account: called without one, the connection asks the customer to sign in on printdash.io.

order.description: The order number (or the order id from its link).

name: approve_order

summary.description: Show this to the customer exactly as written before confirming.

title: Approve a Team order (asks first)
